chunks: Several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from several, from Abu Jameela, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Give charity, even if it is with a Sa' of dates, or even with part of a Sa', or even with a handful, or even with part of a handful, or even with one date, or even with half a date. So whoever cannot find (even that), let him give with soft words.'

For indeed, one of you will meet Allah, and it will be said to him: 'Did I not do (such and such) with you? Did I not make you hearing and seeing? Did I not make for you wealth and children?' So he will say, 'Yes.' Then Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will say: 'So look what you have sent ahead for yourself.'
He said: 'So he will look in front of him, and behind him, and to his right, and to his left, and he will not find anything with which he can shield his face from the Fire.'

key_terms.صَاع: A unit of volume measurement, approximately 3 liters.

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of charity one should give according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia emphasis on the accessibility of charity, affirming that even the poorest can fulfill this obligation through 'soft words' (kalimat layyinah) if material means are absent. It highlights the eschatological accountability for divine blessings (sami‘, basir, mal, walad), warning that neglecting charity leaves one defenseless against the Hellfire, a theme resonating with the concept of *hissab* (accounting) in Shia theology.

en.hubeali:
Someone else from our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from someone else, from Abu Jameela, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Give charity and even if it is with a Sa’a (a unit of measurement) of dates, and even if it is with part of a Sa’a, and even if it is with a handful, and even if it is part of a handful, and even if it is with one date, and even if it is with a part of a date. So the one who cannot find (even that), so with soft words.

So when one of you meet Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, it would be Said to him: “Did I<sup>azwj</sup> not Do (such and such) with you? Did I<sup>azwj</sup> not Make for you hearing, sight? Did I<sup>azwj</sup> not Make wealth and children to be for you?” So he would be saying, ‘Yes’. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High would be Saying: “So look what you have sent for yourself”.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he would look in front of him, and behind him, and on his right, and on his left, so he would not find anything with which he could save his face from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 11. More than one person from our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from more than one narrator from abu Jamilah who has said the following: “This is a narration of abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, from the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.

He (the Messenger of Allah) has said, ‘You must give charity even if it is one Sa‘ (a certain unit of measurement) of dates or less, or a handful or less or one piece of date or less, and if one does not find even this much, he should speak a soothing word.

One of you may come in the presence of Allah who may ask, “Did I not do for you (all the things you have)? Did I not give you eyes and ears; did I not give you property and children?” He will say, “Yes, You gave me all such things.” Allah, the most Blessed, the most High, will say, “Look what you have sent for yourself?”’
He then said, ‘This person then looks around to his front, back, right and left and does not find anything to protect him from the fire.’”
